name: concise-capture-projection
goal: Screenshot cards stay concise and preserve identical-tree images across projections without exposing cache filenames.

evidence: Header captions are redundant. Separately, main 9fb0505e PR32 added cache-filename forwarding to preserve identical-tree images, violating the existing Desktop projection contract. The unchanged recorded-projection test fails at its no-side assertion; header red/green proof is retained at 5c6ef994 and ca66f810.

PR32 browser and Reports checks missed the directly changed Desktop projection guard. Extend its existing derivation matrix with identical-tree and changed-tree focused captures, own getters, iterators and species, and fresh latency/process-memory observations; retain the standard header matrix. Harness guidance now names the projection boundary tests.

Red 0c6b8f55 at 0fc3bfd9 reproduces four projection filename failures, the header render failure and six responsive header failures. The three canonical route cases pass; 165 original screenshots and 400 runtime observations are retained. Admission fixtures do not produce setup errors.

Carry the verified opaque source-tree hash through entity projections and accept it in focused capture selection; keep legacy raw-history locators internal. Remove the two header items. The normal projection matrix guards identity, provenance, changed-tree rejection and filename isolation; isolated mutations will prove both original failures are rejected.

EntityScreens has revision-only captions with image activation preserved. HarnessRevision carries opaque sourceTree identity; the projection copies only a proof-matched hash and focused selection accepts it without forwarding side filenames. Existing contracts and Harness instructions are synchronized; targeted projection/answer tests pass.
